headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 29, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge at the plate. García Jr. went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. In other action, the Texas Rangers took down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes hitting a crucial home run to drive in two runs and secure the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Washington Nationals left-handed pitchers Richard Lovelady and Mitchell Parker, who have been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left triceps strain and left elbow inflammation, respectively. The San Diego Padres have also placed right-handed pitcher David Morgan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 28, 2026, due to left knee inflammation.

The Seattle Mariners have acquired 1B Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash, adding depth to their lineup. The Athletics have also made a trade, acquiring RHP Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Owen Carapellotti.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge at the plate. García Jr. went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs, while Grant Wolfram pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Ryan O'Hearn leading the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers took down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes leading the charge at the plate. Lukes hit a crucial home run, his fourth of the season, to drive in two runs and secure the win.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in a closely contested matchup. Isaac Paredes led the Tigers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Jack Flaherty pitched 5 strong innings for the Astros, striking out 9 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Padres RHP David Morgan Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres right-handed pitcher David Morgan has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation, effective retroactive to June 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have acquired 1B Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that adds depth to their lineup.
